title: Software Engineer III - Java Full Stack Developer + GenAI / LLM + AWS
description:
**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III - Java Full Stack Developer + GenAI / LLM + AWS at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, you'll serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Design and develop full-stack software solutions using modern engineering approaches and patterns.
* Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities, including LLM-based services, orchestration, and workflow integrations.
* Develop and maintain cloud-native microservices and APIs (REST/streaming) with strong focus on scalability, resilience, and security controls.
* Identify and automate solutions for recurring operational issues to improve system stability and observability (logs/metrics/tracing).
* Collaborate in a Scrum/Agile team, participate in ceremonies, and contribute to a culture of diversity, opportunity, and inclusion.
* Implement solutions primarily using Java, Spring Boot, and Python (AWS Lambda), building microservices and Camunda workflow orchestration deployed on AWS ECS, backed by PostgreSQL.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations.
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience.
* Strong application development skills with exposure to operational stability in production environments and hands-on experience in Java Full Stack Development.
* Experience with system design fundamentals, microservices patterns, and API development (RESTful and/or streaming).
* Experience with distributed systems and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Proficiency with data technologies (relational and/or NoSQL) and common observability practices.
* Practical familiarity with LLMs / generative AI concepts and use cases (e.g., RAG, tool/prompt orchestration, guardrails/evaluation); working knowledge of Python for AI/ML integrations.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle, and solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, modern CI/CD practices, multi-region service deployments, and zero-downtime release strategies.
* Strong communication skills, ownership mindset, proactive approach to continuous improvement, and a track record delivering scalable, reliable, and secure products from concept to launch.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Cloud certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Working knowledge of Python (for AI/ML integrations) is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience with multi-region service deployments and zero-downtime release strategies.
* Strong communication skills, ownership mindset, and a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
* Track record delivering scalable, reliable, and secure products from concept to launch.
* Working knowledge of Python (for AI/ML integrations) is a plus.

title: Java Developer – Java EE, Spring, REST APIs & SQL
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a
**Java Full Stack Developer**
to develop, maintain, and enhance Java-based applications and enterprise systems.
  
  
The role will focus on Java and Java EE development, web application frameworks, relational databases, SQL, RESTful web services, version control, and Agile delivery practices. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, and reliable software solutions.
  
  
This position will contribute to business objectives by delivering high-quality application features, improving existing functionality, resolving technical issues efficiently, and supporting secure and sustainable software development practices.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Java: Strong programming and application-development experience.
* Java EE: Strong knowledge of the Java EE platform and enterprise application concepts.
* Web development frameworks: Experience with Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or equivalent Java web development frameworks.
* Relational databases: Knowledge of relational database systems and SQL.
* RESTful web services: Understanding and practical experience developing or integrating RESTful services.
* Git: Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control systems.
* Agile methodologies: Familiarity with Agile software development practices.
* Software engineering: Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, testable, and well-documented code.
* Debugging: Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with multiple Java web development frameworks.
* Exposure to application integration, API development, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Familiarity with automated testing, build tools, deployment tools, and CI/CD practices.
* Knowledge of application performance, logging, monitoring, and production support tools.
* Exposure to cloud-based application development and deployment.

****Version And Experience Guidance****

* Specific Java, Java EE, Spring, Hibernate, JSF, database, and Git versions are not mandated in the requirements.
* Candidates should have experience with current, production-supported versions of the required technologies.
* Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, support upgrades, follow version-control practices, and maintain application stability.
* The qualification requirement specifies at least 3 years of Java software development experience.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Develop and maintain Java-based applications and enterprise systems.
* Design and implement application functionality using Java and Java EE technologies.
* Develop web applications using Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or related frameworks.
* Write clean, maintainable, scalable, reusable, and well-documented code.
* Develop, integrate, and maintain RESTful web services.
* Work with relational databases and SQL to support application data requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop new features and improve existing functionality.
* Participate in requirements discussions, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and application support.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure that code adheres to established coding standards and development practices.
* Debug and resolve technical issues within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to application quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and defect prevention.
* Use Git or equivalent version control systems to manage source code and collaborate with development teams.
* Work within Agile software development methodologies and participate in relevant delivery activities.
* Stay current with developments in Java and related technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve application performance, maintainability, reliability, automation, and efficient use of technical resources.
* Contribute to measurable outcomes such as timely feature delivery, reduced defects, improved application stability, and successful resolution of technical issues.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Strong Java programming skills.
* Strong knowledge of Java EE.
* Understanding of object-oriented programming principles.
* Ability to write modular, reusable, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Ability to apply exception handling, debugging, testing, and software design practices.

****Preferred****

* Experience with additional programming or scripting languages used in enterprise application development.
* Familiarity with asynchronous, event-driven, or distributed application development.
* Experience creating reusable libraries and shared application components.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Knowledge of relational databases.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL.
* Understanding of tables, relationships, joins, indexes, constraints, transactions, and data integrity.
* Ability to develop, analyze, and optimize SQL queries.
* Ability to integrate Java applications with relational databases.
* Understanding of secure data access and appropriate data-handling practices.

****Preferred****

* Experience with stored procedures, database performance tuning, and query optimization.
* Exposure to database migration, data validation, and data-integrity testing.
* Familiarity with additional database technologies.
* Understanding of data backup, recovery, retention, and lifecycle considerations.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Understanding of application deployment and support across development, testing, and production environments.
* Understanding of application scalability, availability, configuration, and operational support.
* Ability to work with environment-specific settings and application integrations.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to cloud-based application development and deployment.
* Familiarity with cloud services, containers, serverless technologies, and infrastructure automation.
* Understanding of cloud resource optimization and sustainable application operations.
* Experience supporting applications in distributed or hybrid environments.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Java EE.
* Spring or equivalent Java web development framework.
* Hibernate or equivalent object-relational mapping framework.
* JSF or equivalent web user-interface framework.
* RESTful web services.
* Java database connectivity and related data-access technologies.
* Frameworks supporting application validation, security, exception handling, and testing.

****Preferred****

* Experience with multiple Java web frameworks.
* Libraries supporting API integration, caching, messaging, logging, and observability.
* Frameworks supporting automated testing and application performance monitoring.
* Exposure to microservices or cloud-native application frameworks.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Git or equivalent version control system.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
* Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience participating in code reviews and applying coding standards.
* Ability to create technical documentation, test cases, design notes, and support procedures.
* Ability to debug technical issues and implement corrective fixes.
* Understanding of collaborative development, defect management, and release practices.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with build and dependency-management tools.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.
* Experience with automated unit, integration, and regression testing.
* Familiarity with Agile ceremonies, iterative planning, and continuous improvement practices.
* Exposure to application monitoring, logging, and production support processes.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Understanding of secure software development practices.
* Knowledge of application authentication, authorization, access controls, and secure configuration.
* Ability to apply input validation, output validation, secure API practices, and appropriate error handling.
* Understanding of secure database access and protection of sensitive information.
* Awareness of risks related to unauthorized access, insecure APIs, injection vulnerabilities, credential exposure, and data leakage.
* Ability to follow organizational security, privacy, compliance, and change-management requirements.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with secure RESTful service implementation.
* Exposure to encryption, secrets management, security testing, and audit logging.
* Experience integrating security checks into development and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of identity and access-management patterns used in enterprise applications.

****Experience Requirements****

* Overall experience: At least 3 years of experience in Java software development.
* Java experience: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Java and Java EE applications.
* Framework experience: Experience with Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or equivalent Java web development frameworks.
* Database experience: Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* API experience: Experience developing or integrating RESTful web services.
* Delivery experience: Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and version control systems such as Git.
* Industry preference: Experience delivering enterprise-scale, business-critical, secure, or highly available applications is preferred.
* Alternative experience pathways: Equivalent combinations of relevant Java development experience, technical training, substantial application delivery, open-source contributions, or demonstrable production implementations may be considered.
* Outcome evidence: Candidates should demonstrate contributions to timely application delivery, improved code quality, reduced defects, successful issue resolution, application stability, or maintainable software solutions.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Develop, enhance, test, debug, and maintain Java and Java EE applications, web components, RESTful services, database integrations, and related software functionality.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams through requirements discussions, technical design sessions, Agile meetings, code reviews, testing activities, and release planning.
* Deliver production-quality code, SQL queries, technical documentation, test results, defect fixes, integration updates, and application-support improvements.
* Make technical decisions within the assigned scope and escalate risks related to application quality, security, performance, maintainability, delivery timelines, and operational support.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least 3 years of experience in Java software development, as specified in the qualification requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with Java, Java EE, Spring, Hibernate or JSF, relational databases, SQL, RESTful web services, and Git.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and experience developing clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through training, technical experimentation, knowledge sharing, and ongoing learning in Java, web development, databases, APIs, security, and modern software engineering.

**Professional Competencies**

* Applies structured problem-solving to analyze requirements, investigate defects, debug complex technical issues, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Works effectively in a team environment and collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver shared application outcomes.
* Communicates technical information clearly through code reviews, documentation, development discussions, status updates, and stakeholder interactions.
* Adapts to changing business requirements, technologies, development practices, delivery priorities, and application constraints through continuous learning.
* Identifies practical opportunities to improve code quality, application performance, maintainability, reliability, security, automation, and sustainable resource use.
* Manages multiple tasks effectively, prioritizes work, meets deadlines, maintains attention to detail, and remains focused during time-sensitive delivery or support activities.

title: Principal Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Join a new systems firmware team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Own complex BMC or BIOS engineering challenges, improve reliability across our server and GPU fleet, and help build the foundation for future platform development with global engineering and hardware partners.**

Firmware connects hardware capability to cloud reliability. At OCI, you will work where those layers meet—investigating challenging failures, developing lasting fixes, and improving how firmware is tested, deployed, and operated across our infrastructure.

As a Principal Systems Firmware Engineer, you will design, develop, and improve BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI and the tools that support its deployment across OCI’s server and GPU infrastructure. You will own complex engineering problems across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, delivering changes that improve platform reliability, diagnosability, security, and recovery.

Your initial focus will be engineering improvements for platforms already operating in our fleet. You will use production findings to identify design weaknesses, develop and validate firmware fixes, extend automated testing, and eliminate recurring failure modes. Success means delivering durable improvements that reduce failures and the need for manual intervention.

You will also participate in an India daytime on-call rotation, complementing US engineering teams. This responsibility connects your engineering work directly to how platforms behave in production and includes incident investigation, mitigation, and coordinated handoffs.

As the team grows, its scope is expected to expand into new server and GPU platform development, with opportunities to work alongside silicon suppliers and ODM/JDM partners on firmware integration, platform bring-up, and validation.

This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team’s engineering practices while remaining deeply involved in design, code, and complex technical investigations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own firmware development and integration.**
Design, develop, debug, and maintain BMC or BIOS/UEFI components and supporting systems software. Define clear interfaces across firmware, hardware, operating systems, and fleet management services.

* **Resolve complex fleet issues.**
  Lead investigations into boot failures, management controller faults, firmware update problems, hardware initialization failures, and other platform reliability issues. Develop mitigations, establish root cause, and deliver durable fixes.
* **Provide operational support.**
  Participate in the India daytime on-call rotation, coordinate investigations and handoffs with US teams, and communicate impact, progress, and resolution clearly.
* **Build automation and preventive controls.**
  Develop tools for firmware provisioning, updates, diagnostics, recovery, and validation. Improve telemetry, logging, and failure analysis to reduce recurring incidents and manual intervention.
* **Drive software quality and security.**
  Write maintainable code, lead design and code reviews, and develop functional, regression, negative, and recovery tests. Apply secure development practices and support firmware vulnerability remediation.
* **Contribute to platform bring-up.**
  Diagnose interactions across firmware, hardware, bootloaders, and operating systems. Use platform logs and appropriate hardware debugging tools to isolate faults and validate end-to-end behavior.
* **Collaborate with engineering and vendor partners.**
  Work with hardware, silicon, operating system, validation, and fleet operations teams. As product development scope grows, work with ODM/JDM partners on requirements, defect resolution, firmware releases, and platform readiness.
* **Provide technical leadership.**
  Own delivery of complex engineering work, identify dependencies and risks, document designs and debugging methods, mentor engineers, and contribute to hiring and continuous improvement.

**Required qualifications**

* Meet one of the following education and software development experience combinations:
* 11 years of software development experience; or
* A bachelor’s degree/B.Tech in a relevant engineering, computing, information technology, mathematics, physics, or related field, with 7 years of software development experience; or
* A master’s degree/M.Tech in one of these fields, with 5 years of software development experience; or
* A doctorate in one of these fields, with 3 years of software development experience.
* At least 6 years of experience using programming and scripting languages, with strong C/C++ skills and the ability to build diagnostic and automation tools.
* Substantial hands-on development and debugging experience in
  **BMC firmware or BIOS/UEFI**
  , with the ability to investigate interactions across the broader server platform.
* Strong understanding of server architecture, embedded systems, hardware/software interfaces, and Linux fundamentals.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, hardware, and operating systems, using evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes.
* Experience owning software components through design, implementation, code review, testing, release, and ongoing support.
* Experience developing automated tests, diagnostics, or operational tooling and improving reliability, observability, or performance.
* Ability to lead technical investigations, mentor colleagues, and communicate effectively across engineering teams and external partners.
* Willingness to participate in the India daytime on-call rotation.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with OpenBMC or other server BMC stacks, or with server BIOS/UEFI implementations such as EDK II or commercial firmware platforms.
* Familiarity with relevant platform interfaces and protocols, such as Redfish, IPMI, PLDM/MCTP, SMBus/I²C, SPI, PCIe, or ACPI.
* Experience with server or GPU platform bring-up, hardware initialization, power and thermal management, or reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) features.
* Experience using JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, or emulators, and interpreting schematics and board documentation.
* Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, update and recovery mechanisms, or firmware security remediation.
* Experience supporting production infrastructure at cloud or hyperscale environments, including controlled firmware rollouts and incident response.

description:

You will design and build AI-powered solutions across multiple industries — translating real business problems into working agentic systems, automations, and intelligent products.

**What You'll Actually Work On**

Most of your time is Python — async services, queue workers, API integrations, and careful debugging. You'll also build and integrate Next.js frontend interfaces that bring those AI systems to life for end users — streaming responses, real-time agent state, and AI-powered product experiences. * Translate business problems into AI/ML solutions and communicate them clearly to non-engineers
* Become an integral part of the product, AI solutions, and AI agents teams — prototype and validate AI use cases across the business
* Collaborate across multiple industries and adapt models and systems to new domains

**Qualifications**

**Must Have**

* 3+ years building AI agent systems and automations for real industry projects
* Solid Python — async/await, FastAPI, raw PostgreSQL (no ORM), Redis, Docker, Git
* Proficient with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and LangChain

* Knowledge of data compliance and security practices across industries
* Familiarity with multi-modal AI (vision + text, tabular + text, etc.)
* Experience with LLM evaluation benchmarks — hallucination, grounding, factuality
* Strong ability to adapt AI models across new domains and industries

**What matters more than your tech stack**

* You understand why a system is shaped the way it is — given a design, you can explain what breaks if a piece moves
* You debug before you assume — check what's actually running before theorising about why it's broken
* You ask before changing direction — if the approach seems wrong, say so and explain why. Don't quietly rebuild it your way
* You explain in plain English to non-engineers — "the form saved to the wrong folder" beats a paragraph of architecture vocabulary
* You care about correctness over cleverness — these systems handle sensitive data for real people. A missed field costs someone hours of manual work

**How We Work**

Small team. Direct access to the ML Engineer and CTO Advisor — no layers between you and the decisions. Architecture decisions are made deliberately and then locked; you extend well-defined systems, not rewrite them. Room to propose new things once you know the ground. Australian data residency is a hard requirement on most products — you'll learn to design within real compliance limits. Everything ships. If you build it, it goes to customers.

* Ownership of real components within your first month
* Collaboration with founders, engineers, and AI researchers
* Flexible remote environment
* Competitive salary with performance-linked component
* Active investment in your continued learning and growth into an AI Lead role

* Optimise performance of ABAP programs and HANA-based queries, and fix defects through root-cause analysis.

**AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Integrate AI capabilities into SAP processes using SAP AI Core, the Generative AI Hub and SAP Business AI features on SAP BTP.
* Build ABAP-to-AI integrations that call ML and LLM services through REST APIs, including prompt design, response handling and error management.
* Develop practical use cases such as document extraction, intelligent classification, anomaly detection, forecasting support and natural-language assistants for SAP data.
* Support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns that use SAP data as grounded context.
* Evaluate model output quality, monitor performance and handle data privacy, access control and audit logging for AI use cases.
* Work with data scientists and solution architects to move AI prototypes into stable production solutions.

**Integration & Automation**

* Build and maintain integrations using OData, REST, SOAP, IDocs, BAPIs and SAP Integration Suite.
* Automate repetitive business and technical tasks using SAP Build Process Automation, workflow tools and scripting (Python).

* Automate SAP Basis tasks such as system health checks, transport and release management, job, spool and dump monitoring, certificate and parameter checks, and post-copy or system refresh steps, using ABAP, shell scripting, Ansible and CI/CD pipelines.
* Build scheduled ABAP programs, OData/REST services and BTP workflows that give Security and Basis teams self-service, low-touch processes with full logging and an audit trail.

* Gather clear and complete requirements from functional consultants, process owners and business users.
* Write technical specifications, unit test cases and handover documentation for support teams.
* Deliver work in an Agile framework as part of cross-functional teams.
* Take part in code reviews, mentor junior developers and share knowledge on ABAP and AI best practice.

**Qualifications:**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience.
* At least 2 years of working experience with AI, ML or Generative AI, either in SAP projects or in related solutions.
* Delivered at least 1–2 full-lifecycle SAP implementation or enhancement projects.

**Technical Skills (Must Have):**

* Strong hands-on skills in ABAP (classic and ABAP OO), Open SQL, CDS views, OData and Fiori backend development.
* Working knowledge of S/4HANA, ABAP on HANA, RAP and ABAP Development Tools (ADT) in Eclipse.

**Good to Have:**

title: LMTS - Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)
description:
**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
  
  
This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
  
  
The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
  
  
We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
* Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.
* One reasoning, tool-use, preference, or reinforcement-learning dataset they created or used: how correctness was established, how contamination was prevented, and how reward hacking or low-quality traces were detected.
* The exact denominator, dataset split, and review method behind any quality or business-impact metric on their resume.
* A difficult production incident or model-quality regression, how they isolated the cause, and the evidence that confirmed the fix.
* A code sample, design document, experiment report, publication, or other artifact that makes their contribution verifiable. Confidential details may be redacted.
* We do not require a PhD, publications, or prior domain experience. We do require depth, honesty about individual contribution, and the ability to turn claims into technical evidence.

description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly technical and innovative AI Engineer with deep expertise in developer workflows, software engineering practices, and Application Security (AppSec). This role will focus on building and assessing AI-driven solutions that enhance the software development lifecycle (SDLC), improve developer productivity, and integrate security seamlessly into engineering workflows.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on experience with modern AI technologies (LLMs, AI agents, RAG, and automation) and deep knowledge of secure software development practices. They will partner within Product Security, and other teams including Engineering, DevOps, and Platform teams to develop intelligent capabilities that help developers build secure software faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI-Powered Developer Workflow**

* Analyze and map end-to-end developer workflows across planning, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and operations.
* Design, build and assess AI-powered solutions that improve developer productivity and engineering efficiency.
* Develop AI agents and copilots for product security team to automate repetitive engineering and security tasks.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and knowledge systems that leverage internal documentation, security standards, and best practices.
* Build integrations across developer tools including GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and IDE platforms.
* Identify bottlenecks in development workflows and recommend AI-based process improvements complying with security standards.

**Application Security**

* Serve as the Application Security Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AI-enabled development initiatives.
* Embed security controls and guidance directly into developer workflows.
* Define approaches for secure code generation and AI-assisted software development.
* Partner within Product Security teams to integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, and container security into AI solutions.
* Develop security guardrails for AI-generated code and AI agents.
* Evaluate and mitigate risks associated with LLMs, AI agents, and autonomous software development.
* Drive Secure SDLC and DevSecOps best practices across engineering organizations.

**AI Solution Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy production-grade application using C#, Asp.net, SQL server, AI applications using modern AI frameworks.
* Partner with business units to build and assess agentic workflows leveraging LLMs and orchestration frameworks.
* Create evaluation frameworks to measure AI model effectiveness, security, and developer adoption.
* Work with large-scale datasets and telemetry to generate actionable engineering insights.
* Develop APIs, services, and integrations supporting enterprise AI capabilities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Security, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Developer Experience teams.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical leaders and executives.
* Influence enterprise AI strategy for secure software development.

**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of software engineering, security engineering, or related experience.
* 3+ years developing AI, ML, or GenAI solutions in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with developer platforms and modern software delivery practices.
* Prior experience in Application Security, Product Security, DevSecOps, or Secure SDLC programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go.
* Experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar.
* Expertise in AI agent frameworks and orchestration platforms.
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, RAG architectures, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

**Application Security Expertise**

* Deep understanding of Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling, OWASP Top 10, SAST, DAST, IAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), Secrets Management, Secure Coding Practices
* Ability to review code and identify security vulnerabilities.
* Familiarity with security tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, Semgrep, SonarQube, or similar.

At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. **Role Summary**

The CMC Solutions Engineer will design and build the semantic and technical foundation for CMC data, with focus on two areas: developing the CMC ontology and knowledge model, and engineering automated, GxP-relevant stability data workflows. Starting with stability monitoring data from CDMO-generated protocols and reports, this role will move CMC data away from siloed, manual processes (SharePoint, email, manual transcription into Excel) toward a structured, ontology-driven, auditable data layer that supports trending, alerting, regulatory reporting, and AI-assisted analysis.

The engineer will work closely with CMC subject matter experts (analytical development, stability, quality, and regulatory CMC), data architecture leads, and existing data catalog/data lake teams to deliver a proof of concept using CDMO data, then iterate toward a scalable, enterprise-reusable solution that extends beyond stability to manufacturing, specifications, reference standards, and document management.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Ontology & Knowledge Modeling**

• Design, build, and maintain the CMC ontology, beginning with the stability domain (studies, protocols, storage conditions, pull points, lots/batches, tests, methods, specifications, results, and impurities) and extending to manufacturing, reference standards, and document management

• Translate CMC business concepts and SME knowledge into well-formed ontologies, controlled vocabulary

• Align and explore applicability of established industry models where appropriate, such as the Allotrope Foundation Ontologies (AFO), Pistoia Alliance IDMP-O, and terminology consistent with ICH Q1 (stability) and ICH Q6 (specifications), rather than building from scratch

• Map extracted and source-system data to ontology classes and properties, and maintain semantic mappings between CDMO-specific terminology and internal standards

• Build and query knowledge graph representations of CMC data to enable cross-study, cross-lot, and cross-CDMO analysis

• Establish ontology governance: versioning, change control, stewardship roles, and documentation that supports use in a regulated environment

**Stability Workflows & Data Engineering**

• Map current-state and design future-state stability workflows end to end, from protocol setup and pull schedules through testing, results review, trending, out-of-trend (OOT) / out-of-specification (OOS) signaling, and reporting for regulatory submissions (e.g., CTD Module 3.2.P.8 / 3.2.S.7)

• Design and build automated pipelines to ingest stability protocols, reports, and results from CDMO-generated PDFs and other sources

title: Technical Architect- Salesforce Devops
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity.
  
  
Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team.
  
  
This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.
  
  
The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub’s Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub’s deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub’s DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
* Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
* Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
* Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
* Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
* Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
* Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
* Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.
* 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
* 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
* Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
* Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
* Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
* Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
* Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
* Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
* Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
* Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
* Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
* Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I (Required)
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (Required)
* Salesforce Certified DevOps Engineer (Required)
* Salesforce Application Architect (Preferred)
* Copado Fundamentals I & II (Preferred)
* Gearset Certified (Preferred)
* GitHub Actions Certification (Preferred)
* Salesforce Administrator (Required)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

description:
**About the role**
We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead Tesco's Mobile Platform team. This team owns the React Native platform, the shared libraries and tooling, and the Mobile CI/CD behind our mobile estate, which serves millions of customers and colleagues every day. Product app teams across Tesco build on what you provide, so your success shows up in their work: a reliable, well-documented platform, shorter and safer release cycles, fewer inconsistencies between apps, and quicker onboarding.
  
As a Software Development Manager, you are a Senior Engineering Team Leader at Tesco. You balance delivery for customers with the needs of the business and the growth of your people, and you stay hands-on. Your proficiency with foundational computer science and software engineering is taken as a given, and you bring proven technical depth and breadth across teams. You will work closely with the Head of Software Development, the senior engineer (SDE3) who sets the platform's technical direction, Lead Product Managers, and Lead UI/UX Designers, turning platform strategy into dependable delivery.
  
Mobile experience is essential for this role. You must have built, shipped, and run native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) in production at real scale. React Native or JavaScript skill on its own is not enough. We need someone who knows the mobile platform properly: app lifecycle, on-device performance, release and signing, and the app store processes.
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
What the team ownsThe React Native mobile platform, built on the Expo ecosystem (EAS, Expo Router), with the shared libraries, common patterns, and app scaffolding that app teams depend on, including how Tesco Digital Design System (DDS) components are pulled in.
  
The model for scaling React Native across many teams, including micro-app and super-app patterns (for example Module Federation with Re.Pack) where they fit.
  
Mobile CI/CD and release infrastructure: build, signing, test automation, distribution, store deployment, and over-the-air updates (EAS Update) for iOS and Android.
  
Developer experience: documentation, examples, a contribution model, migration tooling, and support for the teams that consume the platform.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesDelivery and platformLead the platform engineering team and own the processes and standards that help development succeed and keep improving.
  
Build and evolve the React Native platform and its shared libraries, and treat Mobile CI/CD as a product: fast, reliable pipelines, automated quality gates, application signing, and straightforward App Store and Google Play deployment.
  
Turn the platform direction you agree with the HOSD and the SDE3 into roadmaps, commitments, and shipped work, and make it easier for other teams to build on the platform through documentation, onboarding, and support.
  
Build platform capabilities for performance, scalability, accessibility (AA), and security from a single React Native codebase, and own incident response and root cause analysis.
  
Stakeholders and directionWork with product stakeholders to turn their needs into platform features, and with the HOSD, the SDE3, Lead PMs, and Lead Designers to keep the roadmap aligned.
  
Build agreement within the team on how to approach a solution, and clear the blockers in its way.
  
Use agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) where they genuinely help, and expect the team to use specs, skills, and agents across development, documentation, and testing.
  
People and capabilitySet clear objectives and career paths, review colleague performance, and act on it.
  
Build strong teams, spot and grow talent, and give the team room to innovate.
  
Raise the hiring bar through mentoring, interviewing, and sharing what you know with the wider engineering community.
  
  
  
**You will need**
QualificationsMobile engineering experience (essential): hands-on experience building and shipping native mobile apps (iOS and/or Android) to the App Store and Google Play, and running them in production. This is a firm requirement. We want real mobile platform depth, not web engineers moving across through React Native.
  
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.
  
At least 10 years in software engineering at enterprise or product companies, including time leading or managing engineers, with a good part of it spent on mobile.
  
A track record of building platforms, shared libraries, or developer tooling that other teams use (strongly preferred).
  
Technical SkillsDeep mobile platform fundamentals (essential): hands-on native iOS (Swift or Objective-C) and/or Android (Kotlin or Java), covering app lifecycle, on-device memory and performance, threading, and native module development, which underpin your React Native work.
  
Four or more years building React Native apps with the Expo ecosystem (Expo SDKs, Expo Router, EAS), with a solid grasp of JSI, native modules, and bridging to native iOS and Android.
  
Strong JavaScript and TypeScript (modern ES6 and later), and strong React principles, Hooks, Context API, and component lifecycles.
  
Experience designing and building large front-end or platform systems and shared libraries used by many teams, with sound state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or MobX) and caching.
  
Mobile CI/CD depth: Git and GitHub, CI pipelines, EAS build and submit, application signing, over-the-air updates (EAS Update), and a thorough understanding of the iOS and Android deployment lifecycles and store guidelines (App Store, Google Play).
  
Performance profiling for production apps (Android and iOS profilers), packaging and build tooling (Webpack, Babel), and dependency and release management for shared libraries.
  
Integrating mobile apps with backend APIs (GraphQL or REST), and accessibility to AA standards.
  
Testing frameworks: Jest, React Native Testing Library, Maestro, and Appium.
  
Confident use of agentic AI and AI-assisted tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or Tabnine) across development, documentation, and testing, plus familiarity with MCP integrations and deep linking.
  
Process and Soft SkillsComfortable with Agile methods (Scrum or Kanban), and with JIRA, Confluence, and well-formed epics, stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
Able to apply different delivery processes and knows when each one fits.
  
A self-starter who takes ownership, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
Well organised, with good time management.
  
Clear written and verbal communication.
  
What we offerRelocation help: a professional service to secure the work permits and other documents you need.
  
Learning opportunities: certified technical training and platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, and O'Reilly.
  
A learning culture, with good opportunities to develop your career in your chosen field or in something new.
  
Varied projects to work on, with something new always in the pipeline.
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**

**Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.**

**·**
**Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.

·  
**Specify practical field-data workflows.**
Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.

·  
**Create an infrastructure information system.**
Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.

·  
**Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.

·  
**Unify different analytical sources.**
Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.

·  
**Turn field results into management indicators.**
Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

**Civic Digital Platforms Lead**

**Delivery, quality and collaboration**

**·**
**Plan the release sequence carefully.**
Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.

·  
**Lead testing and technical assurance.**
Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.

·  
**Design future management-room compatibility.**
Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.

·  
**Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.

·  
**Provide for support beyond project close.**
Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

·  Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.

·  Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.

·  Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.

·  Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

·  B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.

·  At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.

·  At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.

·  Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

  **AV1, HEVC/H.265, H.264, VVC**
  ) and processing pipelines (transcoding, rendering, packaging).
* **Streaming Protocols:**
  Mastery of industry-standard delivery protocols including
  **WebRTC, SRT, LL-HLS, and MPEG-DASH**
  to achieve low to ultra-low latency.
* **Content Delivery Networks (CDNs):**
  Expertise in configuring, routing, caching, and optimizing global CDNs (e.g., Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly) for high-concurrency live events.
* **Gaming Infrastructure:**
  Understanding of multiplayer networking architecture, authoritative game servers, matchmakers, tick rates, and anti-cheat systems.
* **Cloud & Edge Computing:**
  Architecture experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) utilizing specialized media services (e.g., AWS Elemental) and edge compute to reduce player/viewer ping.
* **Digital Rights Management (DRM):**
  Implementation of multi-DRM ecosystems including
  **Widevine, FairPlay, and PlayReady**
  alongside watermarking technologies.

**Product & Monetization Skills**

* **Video Monetization Tech (AdTech):**
  Deep familiarity with
  **SSAI (Server-Side Ad Insertion)**
  and
  **CSAI (Client-Side Ad Insertion)**
  , programmatic advertising, and VAST/VMAP protocols.
* **Gaming Economics:**
  Understanding of live-ops, virtual economies, microtransactions (DLCs, battle passes, gacha mechanisms), and player retention loops.
* **Subscription Architecture:**
  Designing flexible billing configurations across multi-tiered monetization models:
  **FAST (Free Ad-Supported TV), AVOD, SVOD, and Hybrid models**
  .

**Data & Performance Analytics**

* **QoE & QoS Management:**
  Tracking and diagnosing critical Quality of Experience (QoE) and Quality of Service (QoS) telemetry such as
  **Video Start Time (VST), buffering ratios, bitrate drops, frame drops, and round-trip time (RTT)**
  .
* **Behavioral Analytics:**
  Utilizing data platforms to track player/viewer engagement metrics, churn prediction patterns, and content consumption habits.

**Compliance & Industry Standards**

* **Regulatory Frameworks:**
  Navigating global content, data, and youth regulations like
  **GDPR, COPPA, and CCPA**
  .
* **Accessibility Standards:**
  Ensuring platform compliance with regulatory mandates like the
  **CVAA**
  (Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act) for closed captioning and audio descriptions.

**Education Background**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering (with a focus on digital signal processing/video), or a highly quantitative, related technical field.**

**Core Professional Experience**

* **15+ years of total software engineering or infrastructure experience, with a minimum of 5+ years specifically architecting large-scale media, streaming, or multiplayer gaming ecosystems.**
* **Proven track record of operating at scale: Experience designing systems that have successfully handled millions of concurrent viewers or players (e.g., major live sports events, viral game launches, global OTT rollouts).**
* **Cross-Domain Mastery: Direct experience bridging the gap between video pipelines (ingestion to playback) and gaming systems (live-ops, low-latency telemetry).**
